rule: Do not assign a single compound qualified/not-qualified label. Evaluate constituent components only when an explicitly identifiable feature-to-truth mapping exists.
component_mapping: Component-level scoring is permitted only after a stratum-specific, validated feature-to-truth mapping is frozen. No such mapping is promoted by this release.
reporting: Report compound rows as a secondary descriptive stratum; they cannot change primary-stratum qualification decisions.
rationale: The current feature schema and qualification model do not provide validated component-specific estimators for all compound strata.
